meta.description: Mahjong — guangdong jihu / hongzhong wild / blood variants × 2-4 players. The JSON's ``variants`` section declares every option (v5.2); the engine selects a variant and player count without any adapter injection. Pure-expression aliases (zero builtins).

to_draw.description: Advance to the draw phase (or end on an empty wall)

do_draw.description: Deal / draw / gang-draw: one tile from the wall

do_discard.description: Discard a tile, open the claim queue

do_claim_pass.description: Pass the claim; open the draw once all pass

do_claim_peng.description: Pung: take the discard, meld a triplet

do_claim_gang.description: Exposed gang: take the discard, meld quads

do_claim_chi.description: Chi (first responder only): meld a run

do_gang_concealed.description: Concealed gang from four held tiles

do_gang_added.description: Added gang: promote a pung to a quad

do_win.description: Common win settlement: fans, winners, continue or end

is_licu.description: 呖咕呖咕 / 八对半: 7 pairs + 1 triplet = 17 tiles (taiwan, concealed)

is_win_hand.description: Winning hand per variant: guangdong/hongzhong/blood = 7 pairs, thirteen orphans, or standard 4 melds + pair (14); taiwan = 呖咕呖咕 or standard 5 melds + pair (17); changsha = 7 pairs / 将将胡 / 258将小胡 / 大胡(碰碰胡·清一色)乱将; sichuan = base wins AND 缺一门 gate (m/p/s distinct < 3).

fan_sum.description: Sum of all fan flags for a winning hand (taiwan: 台数 with 门清/自摸)

payoff_for.description: Net score for one player when ``winner`` wins ``fan_pay``

fan_pengpenghu.description: 碰碰胡 (approx: meld_k triplets — 4 for 14-tile, 5 for taiwan 17-tile)

fan_longqidui.description: 龙七对: one quad + five pairs (14 tiles)

fan_jiangdui.description: 将对: four triplets + pair, every tile 2/5/8

fan_jiangjianghu.description: 将将胡: 14 tiles, every tile 2/5/8, structure-exempt (changsha)

fan_haidilaoyue.description: 海底捞月 (changsha 6 / sichuan 8: win with the wall exhausted)

fan_gangshangkaihua.description: 杠上开花 (changsha 6 / sichuan 8: win right after a gang action)
